title: Eternal Throne
story:
A young prince once visited his grandfather’s palace.

Inside, he saw many rooms.

Different kings had ruled over time.

Paintings of past rulers lined the walls.

Some were strong.

Some were weak.

Some were remembered.

Some were forgotten.

The prince asked,

“Who is the greatest king?”

The old advisor smiled.

He pointed to the empty throne room.

He said,

“All earthly kings come and go.”

“But there is one throne that never loses its authority.”

In life, we trust leaders.

Systems.

People in power.

But all of them change with time.

Only God’s rule remains forever.

His justice is perfect.

His authority never ends.

His throne is eternal.

And His kingdom never fails.
life_lesson:
Earthly authority is temporary.

Only God’s rule and righteousness last forever.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being the eternal King.

Your rule never changes.

Your justice is perfect.

Help me trust Your authority above all else.

Teach me to rest under Your reign.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you rely too much on human authority?

Can you trust God’s eternal rule over your life?

How does knowing God is King bring you peace today?
verse:
Your throne, O God, will last forever and ever.
A scepter of justice will be the scepter of Your kingdom.
